description: submission.rs: when a create fails, the #create_id is correctly absent from submission_email_id_map (only added on Ok path), so onSuccessUpdateEmail/onSuccessDestroyEmail silently skips it. But there is no test verifying this behavior. A test should exercise: create s0 fails (e.g. invalid emailId) + onSuccessUpdateEmail has #s0 → no Email/set side-effect applied. Without this test, a future refactor could break the invariant silently.
title: Test: onSuccessUpdateEmail skips failed #create_id
